# Cold note

The first-search marker is querysyncfir486.

input.initialPublication: none; any seed query is an actual public memory_search over the prepared workspace, with no fixture reindex or separate publication
input.mutationNotification: For create/replace/delete/rename/touch-same-bytes only, Native invokes original exact-owner manager.markMemoryWatchDirty() once after the real filesystem mutation; SDK uses actual source hash/stat detection during its actual search. Native notification supplies a dirty fact without driving a watcher timer or calling sync/reindex; actual watchers stay enabled.
input.settlement: Immediately after actual first public query, call original owner.close() with no intervening same-owner query, private condition wait, event wait, adapter job wait or timer drain. Actual close joins only already-admitted work. Capture complete physical SQL/source state after close return and before acquiring a fresh original owner; then execute actual reopened public query and original fresh-owner close.
input.timers: native debounce=1500ms and all actual monotonic/timer facilities unmodified; no drain, fake timers, reset or pending-timer flush
input.sourceDating: all source paths are original evergreen root/topic memory paths; actual mtime changes remain recorded
input.closeEvidence: Record actual native background-publication calls/promises and their full return/error settlements. All already-admitted original background returns must precede original close return; unexpected failed work is a failed case even if Native catches/logs it. SDK original close owns actual operation/worker completion; no private condition/event wait is used. Keep closed physical state separate from reopened-query effects.
